description: Read append-only schedule binding/lifecycle events by schedule_id, including after active-row deletion. limit is 1 through 100. after is the prior next_cursor composite [created_at,id]. Events include observed baseline or creation, correction/reversal, recovery, execution error/completion and clear, with exact action snapshot, target/status before/after, server-observed actor, reason and revision. History cannot be edited or cleared independently; namespace uninstall retires it.
embedding_description: Read immutable schedule binding and lifecycle history, including after deletion of the active schedule. Page by created_at and id, at most 100 events. Inspect action snapshots, destination changes, revisions, server attribution and reasons for corrections, recovery and terminal transitions.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Read append-only schedule binding/lifecycle events by schedule_id, including after active-row deletion. limit is 1 through 100. after is the prior next_cursor composite [created_at,id]. Events include observed baseline or creation, correction/reversal, recovery, execution error/completion and clear, with exact action snapshot, target/status before/after, server-observed actor, reason and revision. History cannot be edited or cleared independently; namespace uninstall retires it.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Show completeness, holder observation, revision and activation advisories explicitly. A registered route is an observation, not a delivery guarantee.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Read current revision before a mutation. Recovery is a separate explicit action. Pre-boundary queued work is unchanged.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: A stale revision or invalid lifecycle transition is a data-integrity refusal; unavailable observations are advisories.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Read the current owner projection and history, then make an explicit correction with its current revision. Do not recreate a schedule to bypass a stale revision.
